title: Rabbi Hillel of Kifra
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 8:8 and Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:5, Rabbi Mana instructed him to rend [his garment] and mourn. Hyman calls the Rabbi La of Kafrei reading in Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:9 an error.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Pesachim 8:8 and Moed Katan 1:5 paragraphs name Rabbi Hillel of Kifra and Rabbi Mana’s instruction. Sanhedrin 6:9 instead names Rabbi La of Kufra and Rabbi Mani. Hyman’s claim that the latter is an error remains his textual judgment, rather than a repaired reading or merged identity.
